Name: PrintRightScript
Content:
<![CDATA[
function report$PrintRight$GridInit(g, r) {
  if (!r || !g._toolbar) return;
  var hiddenForms = null, toolbarIndex = -1;
  for (var i = 0; i < g._toolbar.length; i++) {
    if (g._toolbar[i][0] == 'Print') {
      toolbarIndex = i;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (toolbarIndex == -1) return;

  var targets, toolbarForm = g._toolbar[toolbarIndex][2], formIndex = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < toolbarForm.length; i++) {
    if (toolbarForm[i].Target) {
      targets = toolbarForm[i].Target.split(',');
      if (targets.length > 1 && Array.contains(r, targets[1])) formIndex.unshift(i);
    } else if (toolbarForm[i].MenuItems) {
      var subToolbar = toolbarForm[i].MenuItems;
      for (var j = 0; j < subToolbar.length; j++) {
        targets = subToolbar[j].Target.split(',');
        if (targets.length > 1 && Array.contains(r, targets[1])) formIndex.unshift(parseFloat(i + '.' + j));
      }
    }
  }

  if (formIndex.length > 0) {
    var o = {Form: formIndex, Value: 1};
    if (g._disableForms) g._disableForms.unshift(o);
    else g._disableForms = [o];
  }
}
]]>

CheckValidEmailFunction
Content:
<![CDATA[
function checkValidEmail$Test(f, fieldName, multiEmail) {
  var s = f.getItemValue(fieldName);
  if (s == '') return true;
  var k1 = s.replace(/;/g, ','), k2 = k1.split(',');
  if (!multiEmail) k2 = [s];
  for (var i = 0; i < k2.length; i++) {
    if !(checkValidEmail$Valid($func.trim(k2[i])))
      return false;
    }
  f.setItemValue(fieldName, k1);
  return true;
}

function checkValidEmail$Valid(email) {
  return (/^\w+([\.-]?\w+)*@\w+([\.-]?\w+)*(\.\w{2,16})+$/.test(email);
}
]]>

select @usedEI = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_sd_hddt'
select @usedEI = isnull(@usedEI, '0'), @eiAllowEdit = '0'
if @usedEI = '1' begin
  select @$pEI = 'hddt00$' + convert(char(6), ngay_ct, 112) from @@table where stt_rec = @stt_rec
  set @q = 'select @$cEI = case when exists(select 1 from ' + @$pEI + ' where stt_rec = ''' + replace(@stt_rec, '''', '''''') + ''' and tinh_trang_hddt <> 0) or exists(select 1 from hddt01 where stt_rec1 = ''' + replace(@stt_rec, '''', '''''') + ''') then 1 else 0 end'

declare @$sd_hddt_yn tinyint, @$mau_hddt varchar(511), @$so_seri_hddt varchar(511), @$so_ct_hddt varchar(511), @$tinh_trang_hddt tinyint, @usedEI char(1), @q nvarchar(4000), @$pEI char(13), @$email nvarchar(1024)
declare @$xu_ly tinyint, @$ghi_chuhoadon nvarchar(511)
select @usedEI = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_sd_hddt'
select @usedEI = isnull(@usedEI, '0')
if @usedEI = '1' begin
  if @@copying = 0 begin
    select @$pEI = 'hddt00$' + convert(char(6), ngay_ct, 112) from @@table where stt_rec = @stt_rec
    create table #hddt(mau_hddt varchar(32), so_seri_hddt varchar(32), so_ct_hddt varchar(32), tinh_trang_hddt char(1))
    set @q = 'insert into #hddt select mau_hddt, so_seri_hddt, so_ct_hddt, tinh_trang_hddt from ' + @$pEI + ' where stt_rec = ''' + replace(@stt_rec, '''', '''''') + ''''
    exec sp_executesql @q
    if exists (select 1 from #hddt) select @$sd_hddt_yn = 1, @$mau_hddt = rtrim(mau_hddt), @$so_seri_hddt = rtrim(so_seri_hddt), @$so_ct_hddt = rtrim(so_ct_hddt), @$tinh_trang_hddt = tinh_trang_hddt from #hddt
    set @q = 'select @$email = e_mail from ' + replace(@$pEI, 'hddt00$', 'v05$') + ' where stt_rec = ''' + replace(@stt_rec, '''', '''''') + ''''
    exec sp_executesql @q, N'@$email nvarchar(1024) out', @$email out
    select @$xu_ly = xu_ly, @$ghi_chuhoadon = ghi_chuhoadon from v03$000000 where stt_rec = @stt_rec
  end else begin
     select @$sd_hddt_yn = 1, @$email = ''
  end
end
